/* 메뉴 */
.mn { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none; }
.mn.on { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(2,4,7,0.6); }
.mn-box { position: relative; width: 600px; max-height: 660px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,28,34,0.97), rgba(11,16,20,0.97)); border: 1px solid #3a4a52; border-radius: 16px; padding: 4px 8px 2px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
.mn-wide .mn-box { width: 900px; }
.mn h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 33px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffe9a8; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000; }
.mn-sub { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #9aa6ab; font-size: 22px; }
.mn-list { overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding: 2px; margin-top: 4px; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.mn-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 8px; font: inherit; font-size: 22px; color: #ece6d4; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }

.mn-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; }
.mn-btn small { margin-left: auto; color: #7d8a90; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; }
.mn-btn em { font-style: normal; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; background: #ece6d4; color: #111; font-size: 22px; flex: none; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
.mn-btn.danger span { color: #ff9a8a; }
.mn-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }
.mn-head { margin: 10px 4px 2px; font-size: 22px; color: #f0b45a; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
.mn-html { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.4; color: #d8d0bc; padding: 0 6px; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
.mn-html p { margin: 0 0 6px; }
.mn-html table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 22px; }
.mn-html th, .mn-html td { text-align: left; padding: 3px 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.35); font-weight: 400; }
.mn-html th { color: #f0b45a; white-space: nowrap; }
.mn-html kbd { display: inline-block; min-width: 24px; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: #ece6d4; color: #111; font: 800 13px/20px inherit; text-align: center; margin: 1px; }
.mn-tog { width: 52px; height: 28px; border-radius: 14px; background: #2c383e; position: relative; flex: none; }
.mn-tog i { position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 3px; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9aa6ab; transition: left 0.12s; }
.mn-tog.on { background: #8a5a1c; }
.mn-tog.on i { left: 27px; background: #ffd890; }
.mn-sl { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.mn-sl b { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #2c383e; font-size: 20px; }
.mn-bar { width: 160px; height: 10px; background: #2c383e; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; }
.mn-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: #f0b45a; }
.mn-sl em { font-style: normal; width: 52px; text-align: right; color: #d8d0bc; font-size: 16px; }
.mn-ch { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.mn-ch b { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #2c383e; font-size: 15px; }
.mn-ch b.on { background: #8a5a1c; color: #ffe6b8; }
.mn-x { position: absolute; right: 2px; top: 0; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 0; background: none; color: #ffe27a; font: inherit; font-size: 33px; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000; cursor: pointer; }

/* 타이틀: 로고는 캔버스(title.ts)가 도트로 그리고, 메뉴는 열린 문 안에 오락실 글자로 */
.mn-title.on { background: none; backdrop-filter: none; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; padding-top: 410px; }
.mn-title .mn-box { background: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none; width: 300px; padding: 0; }
.mn-title .mn-logo { display: none; }
.mn-title .mn-list { gap: 2px; overflow: visible; }
.mn-title .mn-row { background: none; min-height: 52px; justify-content: center; font-size: 33px; color: #a89c84; text-shadow: 0 3px 0 #000, 2px 0 0 #000, -2px 0 0 #000, 0 -2px 0 #000; }
.mn-title .gk-btn.f, .mn-title .gk-btn:hover { border-image: none; }
/* 메뉴는 초점(.f) 하나만 강조: 마우스는 pointermove 가 초점을 옮기므로 :hover·:focus 강조는 끈다 */

.mn-title .mn-row span { position: relative; }
.mn-title .mn-row.f { color: #ffe27a; animation: mn-blink 0.9s steps(1) infinite; }
.mn-title .mn-row.f span::before { content: '▶'; position: absolute; right: calc(100% + 14px); color: #ff5a3a; font-size: 22px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
@keyframes mn-blink { 50% { color: #fff6d0; } }

/* 선택지 (대화·승강기) */
.mn-dialog.on { align-items: flex-end; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 60%); backdrop-filter: none; padding-bottom: 28px; }
.mn-dialog .mn-box { width: 920px; max-height: 470px; }
.mn-dialog h2 { font-size: 24px; color: #ffd890; }

/* 가로 화면 띠 단추: 도트 금속 칸 + 도트 글꼴, 키 이름 없음 (검수 12) */
.tp-side .tp-b { border-radius: 0; background: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 7px; border-image-width: 7px; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; color: #e8dcb8; }

.tp-side .tp-b b, .tp-side .tp-b.small b, .tp-side .tp-b.top b, .tp-side .tp-b.big b { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; }
.tp-side .tp-b.big b { color: #ffb4a0; }
.tp-side .tp-b.on { background: none; filter: brightness(1.7); }
.tp-side .tp-b.hint { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2c94c, 0 0 12px rgba(242,201,76,0.7); }
.tp-side .tp-b.full { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2b632, 0 0 14px rgba(242,182,50,0.9); }
.tp-side .tp-ring { inset: auto 0 -5px 0; height: 4px; border-radius: 0; -webkit-mask: none; mask: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f2b632 calc(var(--g, 0) * 100%), rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0); }
.tp-side .tp-b.item canvas { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
.tp-side .tp-b.item u { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; right: 0; bottom: -4px; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
/* GPT 도트 단추 판 (tools/ui_pixelize.py): 판 그림이 테두리·그림을 다 갖고 있다 */
.tp .tp-b.pl { border: 0; border-image: none; border-radius: 0; background-color: transparent; background-size: contain; background-position: center; background-repeat: no-repeat; image-rendering: pixelated; box-shadow: none; }

.tp .tp-b.pl.item canvas { width: 64%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; }
.tp .tp-b.pl.on { background-color: transparent; filter: brightness(1.45); transform-origin: center; }
.tp .tp-b.pl.hint { box-shadow: none; filter: brightness(1.3) drop-shadow(0 0 0 #f2c94c) drop-shadow(0 0 4px #f2c94c); }
.tp .tp-b.pl.full { box-shadow: none; }

.tp .tp-b.pl.item { background-size: 100% 100%; }

        amount = addAmmo(run, p.ammoLeft);
        if (!amount) return manual ? [{ t: "full", kind: "ammo" }] : [];
        p.ammoLeft -= amount;
        if (!p.ammoLeft) field.ents.splice(field.ents.indexOf(p), 1);
        return [{ t: "pickup", kind: p.kind, amount, ...at2 }];
      }
      case "item":
        amount = addItem(run, p.ref, p.amount);
        if (!amount) return manual ? [{ t: "full", kind: "item", ref: p.ref }] : [];
        break;
      case "relic":
        amount = 0;
        while (amount < p.amount && addRelic(run, p.ref)) amount++;
        if (!amount) return manual ? [{ t: "full", kind: "relic", ref: p.ref }] : [];
        break;
      case "weapon": {
        const prev = equip2(run, p.ref, p.uses);
        field.ents.splice(field.ents.indexOf(p), 1);
        if (prev) spawnPickup(field, "weapon", at2.x, at2.y, prev.id, 1, prev.uses);
        return [{ t: "equip", weapon: p.ref, dropped: prev?.id }];
      }
    }
    p.amount -= amount;
    if (p.amount <= 0) field.ents.splice(field.ents.indexOf(p), 1);
    return [{ t: "pickup", kind: p.kind, ref: p.ref, amount, ...at2 }];
  }
  function stepField(field, run, actor, input, targets, dt, ctx, melee) {
    const ev = [];
    ctx = ctx ? { ...ctx } : void 0;
    if (tickRun(run, dt)) ev.push({ t: "reloaded" });
    const b = field.bounds;
    for (const e of field.ents.slice()) {
      if (e.type === "prop") {
        e.flash = Math.max(0, e.flash - dt);
        continue;
      }
      e.age += dt;
      if (e.z > 0 || e.vz > 0) {
        e.vz -= 1400 * dt;
        e.z += e.vz * dt;
        e.x = Math.max(b.x0, Math.min(b.x1, e.x + e.vx * dt));
        e.y = Math.max(b.y0, Math.min(b.y1, e.y + e.vy * dt));
        if (e.z <= 0) {
          e.z = 0;
          e.vz = Math.abs(e.vz) > 200 ? -e.vz * 0.3 : 0;
          e.vx *= 0.5;
          e.vy *= 0.5;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (e.age < 0.35 || actor.z > 40) continue;
      const auto = e.kind === "cash" || e.kind === "shard" || e.kind === "heal" || e.kind === "ammo";
      const d3 = near(e, actor);
      if (auto && d3 < PICKUP.magnet) {
        e.x += (actor.x - e.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 14);
        e.y += (actor.y - e.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 14);
      }
      if (auto && d3 < PICKUP.touch || (e.kind === "item" || e.kind === "relic") && d3 < PICKUP.touch) ev.push(...take(field, run, e, false, ctx));
    }
    if (input.interact) ev.push(...interact(field, run, actor));
    if (input.attack) ev.push(...attack(field, run, actor, targets, melee).events);
    if (input.shoot || input.shootHeld) ev.push(...shoot(field, run, actor, !input.shoot));
    if (input.use !== void 0) {
      const u = useItem(run, input.use, ctx);
      if (u) {
        ev.push({ t: "use", slot: input.use, id: u.id, effect: u.effect });
        const e = u.effect;
        if (e.type === "salt") ev.push(burst(field, "salt", actor.x, actor.y, e.radius, e.time));
        if (e.type === "flash" || e.type === "smoke")
          field.projs.push({
            id: field.nextId++,
            kind: "grenade",
            ref: u.id,
            x: actor.x + actor.dir * 30,
            y: actor.y,
            z: actor.z + 120,
            vx: actor.dir * 380,
            vz: 360,
            life: 3,
            damage: 0,
            knockback: 0,
            knockdown: false,
            hit: []
          });
      }
    }
    for (const p of field.projs.slice()) {
      p.life -= dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      if (p.kind !== "bullet") {
        p.vz -= 1300 * dt;
        p.z += p.vz * dt;
      }
      let done2 = p.life <= 0 || p.x < b.x0 - 60 || p.x > b.x1 + 60;
      if (p.kind === "grenade") {
        if (p.x < b.x0 || p.x > b.x1) {
          p.x = Math.max(b.x0, Math.min(b.x1, p.x));
          p.vx = 0;
        }
        done2 = p.life <= 0;
        if (p.z <= 0 || done2) {
          const def = ITEMS[p.ref].effect;
          if (def.type === "flash") {
            ev.push(burst(field, "flash", p.x, p.y, def.radius, 0.4));
            for (const t of targets)
              if (Math.hypot(t.x - p.x, (t.y - p.y) * 2) < def.radius)
                ev.push({ t: "hit", target: t.id, damage: 0, knockback: 0, knockdown: false, status: "stun", stun: def.stun, x: t.x, y: t.y, source: p.ref });
          } else if (def.type === "smoke") ev.push(burst(field, "smoke", p.x, p.y, def.radius, def.time, def.slow));
          done2 = true;
        }
      } else {
        for (const t of targets) {
          if (p.hit.includes(t.id) || !hitsTarget(p, t, p.kind === "prop" ? 16 : 0)) continue;
          p.hit.push(t.id);
          const dmg = Math.round(p.damage * (t.human && p.vsHuman ? p.vsHuman : 1));
          ev.push({ t: "hit", target: t.id, damage: dmg, knockback: p.knockback, knockdown: p.knockdown, status: p.status, armorBreak: p.armorBreak, x: t.x, y: t.y, source: p.ref });
          if (p.kind === "bullet" || p.kind === "prop") done2 = true;
          break;
        }
        if (!done2) {
          for (const e of field.ents)
            if (e.type === "prop" && propBox(e, p) && PROPS[e.prop].use !== "throw") {
              ev.push(...damageProp(field, run, e, Math.max(p.damage, 8), targets));
              done2 = true;
              break;
            }
        }
        if (p.kind === "prop" && (done2 || p.z <= 0)) {
          done2 = true;
          const def = PROPS[p.ref];
          ev.push({ t: "break", prop: p.ref, x: p.x, y: p.y });
          if (def.burst) ev.push(...explode(field, run, def.burst, p.x, p.y, def.id, targets, def.knockdown));
          else ev.push(burst(field, "blast", p.x, p.y, 40, 0.25));
        }
      }
      if (done2) field.projs.splice(field.projs.indexOf(p), 1);
    }
    for (const z of field.zones.slice()) {
      z.t += dt;
      if (z.t >= z.life) field.zones.splice(field.zones.indexOf(z), 1);
    }
    return ev;
  }

  // src/game/action/items/shop.ts
  function openShop(vendor, run, depth, seed) {
    const st = { seed: seed | 0 || 7 };
    const v = VENDORS[vendor];
    const offers = [];
    const greet = v.greet[Math.floor(rand(st) * v.greet.length)];
    if (vendor === "madeokhee") {
      const pool = ["medkit", "bandage", "antidote", "salt", "flash", "smoke", "charm", "energy", "adrenaline"];
      const picks = ["medkit"];
      while (picks.length < 4) {
        const id = pool[Math.floor(rand(st) * pool.length)];
        if (!picks.includes(id)) picks.push(id);
      }
      for (const id of picks) {
        const d3 = ITEMS[id];
        offers.push({ key: "i:" + id, kind: "item", ref: id, name: d3.name, desc: d3.desc, price: priceAt(d3.price, depth), stock: id === "medkit" ? 3 : 2 });
      }
      const sig = SIGNATURES[run.agent];
      if (sig && sig.ammo !== "none") {
        const a = AMMO_PICKUP[sig.ammo];
        offers.push({ key: "ammo", kind: "ammo", ref: sig.ammo, name: a.name, desc: `${sig.ranged} 예비 +${a.amount}`, price: priceAt(sig.ammo === "rifle" ? 30 : 15, depth), stock: 4 });
      }
      if (rand(st) < 0.6) {
        const ws = ["pipe", "kitchenknife", "servicepistol", "shotgun", "smg"];
        const id = ws[Math.floor(rand(st) * ws.length)];
        const w = WEAPONS[id];
        offers.push({ key: "w:" + id, kind: "weapon", ref: id, name: w.name, desc: `${w.cls === "gun" ? "총" : "한 손 근접"} · ${w.cls === "gun" ? "탄" : "내구"} ${w.uses} · ${w.desc}`, price: priceAt(w.cls === "gun" ? 55 : 30, depth), stock: 1 });
      }
    } else if (vendor === "backalley") {
      for (const c of CLINIC) offers.push({ key: "c:" + c.id, kind: "clinic", ref: c.id, name: c.name, desc: c.desc, price: priceAt(c.price, depth), stock: 1 });
    } else if (vendor === "shinyuri") {
      LOANS.forEach(
        (l, i) => offers.push({ key: "l:" + i, kind: "loan", ref: String(i), name: `현금 ${l.cash}`, desc: `귀환 후 예산 ${l.debt} 상환. 못 갚으면 유물 압류`, price: 0, stock: 1, debt: l.debt })
      );
    } else {
      offers.push({ key: "g:cash", kind: "gamble", ref: "cash", name: "동전 넣기", desc: "무작위 아이템 하나", price: priceAt(25, depth), stock: 3 });
      offers.push({ key: "g:hp", kind: "gamble", ref: "hp", name: "다른 것을 넣기", desc: "체력 20%를 내고 무작위 아이템 하나", price: 0, stock: 2, hpCost: 0.2 });
    }
    return { vendor, depth, seed: st.seed, offers, buys: vendor === "madeokhee", greet };
  }
  function buy2(shop, run, key2, ctx) {
    const o = shop.offers.find((x) => x.key === key2);
    if (!o || o.stock <= 0) return { ok: false, why: "stock" };
    if (run.cash < o.price) return { ok: false, why: "cash" };
    if (o.hpCost && (!ctx || !Number.isFinite(ctx.hp) || !Number.isFinite(ctx.max) || ctx.max <= 0 || ctx.hp - ctx.max * o.hpCost < 1))
      return { ok: false, why: "cash", currency: "hp" };
    let res;
    switch (o.kind) {
      case "item":
        if (!canAddItem(run, o.ref)) return { ok: false, why: "full" };
        addItem(run, o.ref);
        res = { ok: true, got: o.name };
        break;
      case "ammo":
        if (!addAmmo(run)) return { ok: false, why: "ammoFull" };
        res = { ok: true, got: o.name };
        break;
      case "weapon":
        equip2(run, o.ref);
        res = { ok: true, got: o.name };
        break;
      case "clinic": {
        const c = CLINIC.find((x) => x.id === o.ref);
        const heal2 = ctx && Number.isFinite(ctx.hp) && Number.isFinite(ctx.max) && ctx.hp > 0 && ctx.hp < ctx.max ? c.heal : 0;
        const cure = c.cure.filter((status) => ctx?.curable?.includes(status));
        if (!heal2 && !cure.length) return { ok: false, why: "stock", message: "지금은 받을 수 있는 치료가 없다" };
        res = { ok: true, got: o.name, heal: heal2, cure };
        break;
      }
      case "loan": {
        if (run.debt > 0) return { ok: false, why: "loan" };
        const l = LOANS[+o.ref];
        run.cash += l.cash;
        run.debt += l.debt;
        for (const x of shop.offers) if (x.kind === "loan") x.stock = 0;
        return { ok: true, got: o.name };
      }
      case "gamble": {
        const st = { seed: shop.seed };
        const ids = Object.keys(ITEMS).filter((id2) => canAddItem(run, id2));
        if (!ids.length) return { ok: false, why: "full" };
        const id = ids[Math.floor(rand(st) * ids.length)];
        shop.seed = st.seed;
        addItem(run, id);
        res = { ok: true, got: ITEMS[id].name, hpCost: o.hpCost };
        break;
      }
    }
    run.cash -= o.price;
    o.stock--;
    return res;
  }
  function sell(shop, run, bagIndex) {
    const b = run.bag[bagIndex];
    if (!shop.buys || !b) return 0;
    const price = sellPrice(shop, b.value);
    run.bag[bagIndex] = null;
    run.cash += price;
    return price;
  }
  var sellPrice = (shop, value) => Math.round(value * (1 + shop.depth * 0.03));

  // src/game/action/items/icons.ts
  var C2 = {
    heal: "#5fbf6a",
    cure: "#4fb3b3",
    throw: "#e08a3c",
    special: "#9a7fd1",
    metal: "#9aa4ab",
    dark: "#4a5258",
    wood: "#a07850",
    gold: "#d6b64a",
    cash: "#e6d36a",
    red: "#d65a5a",
    white: "#e8ecee",
    shard: "#c77dff"
  };
  var rect = (g2, c, x, y, w, h) => {
    g2.fillStyle = c;
    g2.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  };
  var circ = (g2, c, x, y, r) => {
    g2.fillStyle = c;
    g2.beginPath();
    g2.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g2.fill();
  };
  var poly = (g2, c, pts) => {
    g2.fillStyle = c;
    g2.beginPath();
    g2.moveTo(pts[0], pts[1]);
    for (let i = 2; i < pts.length; i += 2) g2.lineTo(pts[i], pts[i + 1]);
    g2.closePath();
    g2.fill();
  };
  var line = (g2, c, w, pts) => {
    g2.strokeStyle = c;
    g2.lineWidth = w;
    g2.lineCap = "round";
    g2.beginPath();
    g2.moveTo(pts[0], pts[1]);
    for (let i = 2; i < pts.length; i += 2) g2.lineTo(pts[i], pts[i + 1]);
    g2.stroke();
  };
